enterprise_skill_evaluation.evidence: 50/50 JSON policy fixtures (27 prior unchanged), 7/7 adversarial strategy tests, 2/2 mutation-oracle tests and 5/5 browser policy tests. A deliberately unsafe policy copy was rejected by the real packager. Offline browser DOM/screenshot succeeded; network smoke skipped due to administrator restriction. Scores are assessor judgments, not independent runtime measurements.
enterprise_skill_evaluation.blockers: No static packaging blocker. Live browser network routing and real Claude Code integration remain untested; conversion uplift unmeasured.
enterprise_skill_evaluation.revisions: Preserved the existing precision engine and browser observation; hardened executable browser release gate, v2 mode/decision matrix, CTA schemes, typed JSON validation, publication evidence artifact references and negative regression tests.
enterprise_skill_evaluation.reason: Static and adversarial unit tests pass; runtime, legal truth, browser network isolation and measured business impact remain unverified.
